subject: Kickoff: MAP + contracting playbook for Acme POC
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + contracting playbook for Acme POC

Hi Liam / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to get the mutual action plan (MAP) and contracting path on the calendar so we all have clear owners and milestones for the POC and pilot procurement. I attached a first-pass MAP and an evaluation plan for the technical pilot.

High level ask: please confirm your preferred legal contact (person + email) and any internal PO / procurement steps we should factor into the timeline. Below are the roles and proposed milestones to start — feel free to edit.

Owners (proposed)
- Commercial / Deal lead: Diego Fernandez (Redwood)
- Legal / Terms owner (Acme): Liam to confirm
- Technical lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole
- Technical lead (Acme): Samantha Price
- Procurement / PO: procurement@acme-retail.com

Key milestones (target dates — editable)
- MAP kickoff & stakeholder alignment: Nov 20 (today)
- Evaluation plan signoff (SOW + test cases): Nov 27
- Terms exchange (initial redline): Nov 30
- Final redline + internal approvals: Dec 7
- PO issuance / signature window: Dec 14–18
- Pilot start: Jan 4, 2027

Contracting process notes
- We generally prefer a single contract + SOW for POC that can be upgraded to a pilot amendment.
- For speed, we can accept redlines via shared doc (preferred) and then move to DocuSign for execution; I linked a sample Docusign route in related links.
- If you have a mandated clause flow (vendor questionnaire, SOC2 evidence review), please list it and we will prioritize.

Attachments in this email: Redwood_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (MAP draft), Evaluation_Plan_Acme.docx (testcases/eval criteria).

Next steps for today
1) Liam — please confirm legal/contact person and whether Acme requires an NDA before sharing additional evidence (we can escalate SOC2 package on request).
2) Procurement — confirm typical PO lead times or preferred PO template.
3) Marissa / Rishi (internal) — I'll collect any additional commercial constraints and post an updated MAP to the HubSpot deal record.

Thanks — looking forward to the sprint.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com, Samantha Price <samantha.price@acme-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + contracting playbook for Acme POC

Diego — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes:

- I am our business-side owner for the POC but legal will be led by Samantha Price (copied). Her team manages vendor terms and will run the redline.
- Procurement (procurement@acme-retail.com) handles PO issuance — typical lead time is 2–3 weeks once terms are signed, but we can sometimes expedite for pilots if legal signs off.
- We will need a short vendor questionnaire completed for our security review. Samantha — can you confirm the questionnaire contact?

Timeline looks reasonable. For terms exchange, can we aim to get a first redline back by Nov 30? We should plan internal review the week of Dec 6.

Liam O'Connor
Senior Program Manager — Retail Technology
Acme Retail

Thanks Samantha (and team) — great to have you on this. Per Liam's note, we appreciate a target of Nov 30 for the initial redline. To keep things moving, wanted to propose a simple redline workflow that has worked for similar customers:

Proposed redline flow (fast path)
1) Acme legal posts a single redline document in the shared Drive (or sends track changes in Word) 
2) Redwood legal does an initial pass and returns consolidated comments within 48 business hours
3) If changes are limited, we move to DocuSign for signatures; otherwise we do one focused phone call to resolve outstanding commercial/legal items.

I attached a suggested redline starter document (proposed-terms-redline.docx) and have added a HubSpot note with the MAP and timelines. If you prefer, Redwood legal can start with an exceptions list to speed parsing on your end — Marissa / Rishi, can you confirm who will own initial exceptions?

Proposed timeline update based on legal availability
- Nov 30: Acme initial redline (target)
- Dec 2: Redwood initial pass complete
- Dec 6–8: focused alignment call / final negotiation
- Dec 14: signature window opens (DocuSign)

Security / evidence: we can provision SOC2 artifacts and a short questionnaire PDF — happy to upload to a secure share if Samantha confirms the contact.

Diego

Samantha / Liam — quick follow-up from Redwood legal & product:

- Rishi will own the initial exceptions list and I will own coordinating the technical SOW updates once terms are stable. Expect the exceptions doc from Rishi by EOD Dec 2 (today).
- Please indicate if Acme requires any particular indemnity cap or data-processing addendum language up front so we can include it in the exceptions list.
- Can procurement flag any blackout dates for approvals in mid-December? That will affect our signature window.

Next immediate items
1) Rishi — upload exceptions doc to the Drive link and ping Samantha when done.
2) Samantha — confirm questionnaire contact and whether you prefer the SOC2 bundle via SFTP or secure Drive.
3) Liam — confirm availability for a 30-minute alignment call during Dec 6–8.

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal and move the MAP to version 1.0 after Rishi’s upload.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
